headline: Bulldog Peggy Sue Loses 20 Pounds and Finds Forever Home
meta_description: A severely overweight shelter bulldog named Peggy Sue shed 20 pounds through careful care and exercise, then found a loving home during a charity adoption driv…
summary_short: Peggy Sue, a 70-pound bulldog who could barely walk, lost weight with dedicated foster care and found a new family who say she's now thriving and full of joy.
body:
When Peggy Sue arrived at the RSPCA's West Hatch Animal Centre in Somerset, England, last July, the massive bulldog weighed 70 pounds—nearly the weight of a baby hippo. She was so overweight that she struggled to walk more than a few steps without collapsing, battled constant infections, and frequently overheated. Staff had to physically carry her in a crate from the transport van to her kennel. "It was awful to see her struggle with every day movement," said RSPCA Deputy Centre Manager Anita Clark. "She really needed some care and attention."

The turning point came when a dedicated foster caretaker began gradually increasing Peggy Sue's exercise routine. Day by day, small improvements emerged. Combined with a strict diet plan, the changes proved transformative. By the time the charity's recent 'Adoptober' adoption drive took place, Peggy Sue had shed 20 pounds, bringing her weight down to a much healthier 23.5 kilograms.

Her new owners, Emmie and Andy from Taunton, adopted her as their sixth rescue dog. They've discovered a playful, water-loving companion who enjoys rock pools and streams. Peggy Sue has also formed a close bond with the couple's Jack Russell mix, who had recently lost its long-time sibling. "When she first came home she only showed small bursts of energy, but little by little she has built up her strength and now she is utterly amazing and loves her walks and trips in the car," Emmie shared. For this bulldog once unable to move, the journey from struggle to joy represents a second chance fully seized.
quick_facts: Peggy Sue weighed 70 pounds when she arrived at the shelter
RSPCA West Hatch Animal Centre in Somerset, England
Lost 20 pounds through foster care and exercise plan
Adopted during 'Adoptober' charity drive to Taunton family
Now thrives with new owners and canine companion
